name: VolunteerProjectCard - Linked Through To Its Detail Page
description: One project card with every optional field filled: thumbnail, time commitment, blurb, and sign-up link. The thumbnail and title link to the project's detail page; the footer has a small 'Read the full description →' link above a solid 'Get involved' pill — answering the report that a card's thumbnail looked clickable but led nowhere. The apply link stays its own control rather than being swallowed by a card-wide anchor, which would be invalid nested markup and unusable by keyboard.
